title: RemixCN components.json
description: Where remixcn installs RemixCN items in a Remix 3 app. It follows shadcn's components.json without the Tailwind and React settings, and keeps any other field.

rsc.description: RemixCN components are not React Server Components.

css.description: The theme stylesheet, relative to the app. Link it first in <head>.

aliases.description: Import aliases that resolve through package.json imports or tsconfig.json paths to the directories items install in. Keep them under app/**/public/ so the browser can load them.

lib.description: Helpers, the theme and the license texts: @lib/ targets.

registries.description: Registry namespaces and their item URL templates. remixcn adds @remixcn.

additionalProperties.description: An HTTPS URL with a {name} placeholder. Plain HTTP works only for localhost.
